mapper.sql: (COALESCE(ir.decision, 0) = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM resume sr WHERE sr.resume_id = COALESCE(ir.resume_id, (SELECT ss.resume_id FROM interview_schedule ss WHERE ss.schedule_id = ir.schedule_id)) AND sr.status = 5))
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO interview_result (schedule_id, resume_id, cycle_id, user_id, decision) SELECT live.schedule_id, r.resume_id, r.cycle_id, COALESCE(r.user_id, live.user_id), 0 FROM resume r LEFT JOIN interview_schedule live ON live.resume_id = r.resume_id AND live.cycle_id = r.cycle_id AND live.status = 1 WHERE r.cycle_id = #{cycleId} AND r.status >= 2 AND r.status <> 5 AND COALESCE(r.user_id, live.user_id) IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM interview_result x WHERE x.cycle_id = r.cycle_id AND x.resume_id = r.resume_id)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM interview_result y JOIN interview_schedule ys ON ys.schedule_id = y.schedule_id WHERE ys.resume_id = r.resume_id AND ys.cycle_id = r.cycle_id) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE result_id = result_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS candidates, COALESCE(SUM(ir.decision = 0), 0) AS pending, COALESCE(SUM(ir.decision = 3), 0) AS adjusting, COALESCE(SUM(ir.decision = 1), 0) AS admitted, COALESCE(SUM(ir.decision = 2), 0) AS rejected, COALESCE(SUM(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pre_admission_draft pad WHERE pad.result_id = ir.result_id) AND ir.decision IN (0, 3)), 0) AS in_pre_admission, COALESCE(SUM(ir.notified_at IS NOT NULL), 0) AS notified FROM interview_result ir LEFT JOIN interview_schedule isc ON ir.schedule_id = isc.schedule_id WHERE COALESCE(ir.cycle_id, isc.cycle_id) = #{cycleId} AND NOT

SELECT d.dept_id, d.dept_name, COALESCE(SUM(b.first_dept_id = d.dept_id), 0) AS first_choice, COALESCE(SUM(b.second_dept_id = d.dept_id), 0) AS second_choice, COALESCE(SUM(b.draft_dept_id = d.dept_id AND b.decision IN (0, 3)), 0) AS pre_admitted, COALESCE(SUM(b.decision = 1 AND b.assigned_dept_id = d.dept_id), 0) AS admitted, COALESCE(SUM(b.decision = 1 AND b.assigned_dept_id = d.dept_id AND b.first_dept_id <=> d.dept_id), 0) AS admitted_first_choice, COALESCE(SUM(b.decision = 1 AND b.assigned_dept_id = d.dept_id AND NOT (b.first_dept_id <=> d.dept_id) AND b.second_dept_id <=> d.dept_id), 0) AS admitted_second_choice, COALESCE(SUM(b.decision = 1 AND b.assigned_dept_id = d.dept_id AND NOT (b.first_dept_id <=> d.dept_id) AND NOT (b.second_dept_id <=> d.dept_id)), 0) AS admitted_other, COALESCE(SUM(b.decision = 1 AND b.assigned_dept_id = d.dept_id AND b.notified_at IS NOT NULL), 0) AS admitted_notified FROM department d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ir.result_id, ir.decision, ir.assigned_dept_id, ir.notified_at, ip.first_dept_id, ip.second_dept_id, pad.assigned_dept_id AS draft_dept_id FROM interview_result ir LEFT JOIN interview_schedule isc ON ir.schedule_id = isc.schedule_id LEFT JOIN interview_preference ip ON ip.resume_id = COALESCE(ir.resume_id, isc.resume_id) LEFT JOIN pre_admission_draft pad ON pad.result_id = ir.result_id WHERE COALESCE(ir.cycle_id, isc.cycle_id) = #{cycleId} AND NOT ) b ON (b.first_dept_id = d.dept_id OR b.second_dept_id = d.dept_id OR b.assigned_dept_id = d.dept_id OR b.draft_dept_id = d.dept_id) GROUP BY d.dept_id, d.dept_name, d.status
HAVING d.status = 1 OR COUNT(b.result_id) > 0 ORDER BY d.dept_id

SELECT ir.result_id, /* * 面试安排实时回退：结果行是「从面试安排生成名单」建的， * 若当时还没排面试则 ir.schedule_id 为空，之后再分配也不会回填—— * 界面会一直显示「无面试」，连带面试分与结论都取不到（它们经 schedule 联表）。 * 这里按简历+周期反查生效安排补上，排完面试立刻就能看到，不必重新生成名单。 */ COALESCE(ir.schedule_id, live.schedule_id) AS schedule_id, ir.user_id, ir.decision, ir.assigned_dept_id, ir.decision_by, ir.decision_at, ir.created_at, ir.updated_at, ir.notified_at, ir.resume_id, -- 优先用结果自身的 cycle_id：没有面试安排的结果查不到 isc.cycle_id（V34） COALESCE(ir.cycle_id, isc.cycle_id) AS cycle_id, u.name as user_name, d.dept_name as department_name, -- 录取决策的三个依据并到一行，免得在「评价汇总」「简历管理」之间来回切： -- 简历分（未署名 = 没打过分 → NULL，不能把默认 0 当成打过 0 分）、 -- 面试评价加权总分与结论、志愿部门 CASE WHEN rs.scored_by IS NULL AND rs.scored_at IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE rs.resume_score END AS resume_score, live.interview_time AS interview_time, ev.total_score AS eval_total_score, ev.recommendation AS eval_recommendation, d1.dept_name AS first_dept_name, d2.dept_name AS second_dept_name, /* * 是否线上面试，决定排序（线上排最后）。两种来源： * 1) 有生效安排：看安排上的 interview_mode（改期转线上、管理员安排线上都会置 1）； * 2) 没有安排：简历里选了「不能参加线下面试」（expected_interview_time.canAttend = no）， * 这批人不进线下排期，由管理员单独约线上。 * 没排上场次但能来线下的（人数原因落选）不算线上。 * JSON_EXTRACT 遇到非法 JSON 会让整条查询报错，所以先 JSON_VALID 再取—— * CASE 保证只在合法时才求值 THEN 分支。 */ CASE WHEN live.schedule_id IS NOT NULL THEN live.interview_mode = 1 ELSE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM resume_field_value fv JOIN resume_field_definition fd ON fd.field_id = fv.field_id WHERE fv.resume_id = COALESCE(ir.resume_id, isc.resume_id) AND fd.cycle_id = COALESCE(ir.cycle_id, isc.cycle_id) AND fd.field_key = 'expected_interview_time' AND (CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(fv.field_value) THEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(fv.field_value, '$.canAttend')) END) = 'no') END AS online_interview FROM interview_result ir LEFT JOIN interview_schedule isc ON ir.schedule_id = isc.schedule_id LEFT JOIN user u ON ir.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN department d ON ir.assigned_dept_id = d.dept_id LEFT JOIN resume rs ON rs.resume_id = COALESCE(ir.resume_id, isc.resume_id) -- 该简历在本周期的生效面试安排（status=1）；一份简历一届只排一次（uk_resume_cycle） LEFT JOIN interview_schedule live ON live.resume_id = COALESCE(ir.resume_id, isc.resume_id) AND live.cycle_id = COALESCE(ir.cycle_id, isc.cycle_id) AND live.status = 1 -- 评价也走回退后的安排 id，否则后排的面试评价永远关联不上 LEFT JOIN interview_evaluation ev ON ev.schedule_id = COALESCE(ir.schedule_id, live.schedule_id) LEFT JOIN interview_preference ip ON ip.resume_id = COALESCE(ir.resume_id, isc.resume_id) LEFT JOIN department d1 ON ip.first_dept_id = d1.dept_id LEFT JOIN department d2 ON ip.second_dept_id = d2.dept_id
AND COALESCE(ir.cycle_id, isc.cycle_id) = #{cycleId}
AND u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND ir.decision = #{decision}
AND d.dept_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{department}, '%')
AND NOT
ORDER BY online_interview ASC, ir.created_at DESC, ir.result_id DESC

SELECT ir.result_id, ir.decision, ir.assigned_dept_id, ir.notified_at, COALESCE(ir.cycle_id, isc.cycle_id) AS cycle_id FROM interview_result ir LEFT JOIN interview_schedule isc ON ir.schedule_id = isc.schedule_id WHERE COALESCE(ir.cycle_id, isc.cycle_id) = #{cycleId} AND ir.decision IN (0, 3) AND NOT AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pre_admission_draft pad WHERE pad.result_id = ir.result_id) AND ir.result_id IN #{id} FOR UPDATE OF ir

SELECT ir.result_id FROM interview_result ir LEFT JOIN interview_schedule isc ON ir.schedule_id = isc.schedule_id WHERE COALESCE(ir.cycle_id, isc.cycle_id) = #{cycleId} AND ir.decision = 0 AND NOT AND ir.result_id IN #{id}
